description: A water salesman collects water from a glacier and transports it in either small or large kegs. A small keg can hold 40 liters of water while a large keg can hold 100 liters of water. The salesman has available at most 30 small kegs and 10 large kegs. Since small kegs are easier to carry, at least twice as may small kegs must be used than large kegs. If he can transport at most 25 kegs total and at least 5 kegs must be large, how many of each should he use to maximize the total amount of glacial water he can transport?

SmallKegCapacity.definition: Capacity of a small keg in liters

LargeKegCapacity.definition: Capacity of a large keg in liters

MaxSmallKegsAvailable.definition: Maximum number of small kegs available

MaxLargeKegsAvailable.definition: Maximum number of large kegs available

SmallKegMultiplier.definition: The multiplier for the number of small kegs to be used compared to large kegs

MaxTotalKegs.definition: Maximum total number of kegs that can be transported

MinLargeKegs.definition: Minimum number of large kegs that must be used

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total amount of glacial water transported using small and large kegs"
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    SmallKegCapacity * SmallKegsUsed + LargeKegCapacity * LargeKegsUsed,
    GRB.MAXIMIZE
)

constraints.description: Number of small kegs used must be less than or equal to MaxSmallKegsAvailable
MinLargeKegs must be less than or equal to the number of large kegs used, which must be less than or equal to MaxLargeKegsAvailable
Number of small kegs used must be at least SmallKegMultiplier times the number of large kegs used
Total number of kegs used (small plus large) must be less than or equal to MaxTotalKegs

SmallKegsUsed.definition: Number of small kegs used for transporting water

LargeKegsUsed.definition: Number of large kegs used for transporting water
